---
title: "HindiBabyNet Prosody Statistical Analysis Report"
author: "Arun Prakash Singh"
date: "`r format(Sys.Date(), '%d %B %Y')`"
output:
  pdf_document:
    toc: yes
  html_document:
    theme: flatly
    toc: yes
    toc_float: yes
    number_sections: yes
    code_folding: show
    df_print: paged
params:
  run_workflow: false
  nsim: 1000
  model_robustness_mode: "strict"
  family1_age_specification: "linear"
  family2_count_age_specification: "linear"
  family2_duration_age_specification: "linear"
  confidence_level: 0.95
  speaker_reference_level: "adult_female"
  child_sex_reference_level: "female"
  city_reference_level: "CNB"
  primary_acoustic_measures: !r c("median_F0_Hz", "robust_pitch_range_Hz", "wav2vec_PC1", "wav2vec_PC2", "wav2vec_PC3", "hubert_PC1", "hubert_PC2", "hubert_PC3")
  sensitivity_acoustic_measures: !r c("mean_F0_Hz", "mean_F0_ST", "median_F0_ST", "robust_pitch_range_ST")
  show_code: true
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = params$show_code,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  fig.align = "center",
  fig.width = 9,
  fig.height = 5.5,
  dpi = 120
)

options(width = 120, scipen = 999)

collapse_param_values <- function(values) {
  if (is.null(values) || length(values) == 0) {
    return("")
  }

  values <- trimws(as.character(unlist(values, use.names = FALSE)))
  values <- values[nzchar(values)]
  if (length(values) == 0) {
    return("")
  }

  paste(values, collapse = ";")
}

apply_report_environment_overrides <- function() {
  Sys.setenv(
    HBN_PROSODY_NSIM = as.character(params$nsim),
    HBN_PROSODY_CONFIDENCE_LEVEL = as.character(params$confidence_level),
    HBN_PROSODY_MODEL_ROBUSTNESS_MODE = as.character(params$model_robustness_mode),
    HBN_PROSODY_FAMILY1_AGE_SPEC = as.character(params$family1_age_specification),
    HBN_PROSODY_FAMILY2_COUNT_AGE_SPEC = as.character(params$family2_count_age_specification),
    HBN_PROSODY_FAMILY2_DURATION_AGE_SPEC = as.character(params$family2_duration_age_specification),
    HBN_PROSODY_SPEAKER_REF = as.character(params$speaker_reference_level),
    HBN_PROSODY_CHILD_SEX_REF = as.character(params$child_sex_reference_level),
    HBN_PROSODY_CITY_REF = as.character(params$city_reference_level),
    HBN_PROSODY_PRIMARY_MEASURES = collapse_param_values(params$primary_acoustic_measures),
    HBN_PROSODY_SENSITIVITY_MEASURES = collapse_param_values(params$sensitivity_acoustic_measures)
  )
}

apply_report_environment_overrides()

if (isTRUE(params$run_workflow)) {

read_output_csv <- function(name) {
  path <- file.path(analysis_paths$outputs_tables, name)
  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    return(data.frame(note = sprintf("Missing output: %s", name), stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
  }
  utils::read.csv(path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
}

render_table <- function(data, caption = NULL, digits = 3) {
  if (is.null(data) || nrow(as.data.frame(data)) == 0) {
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  print(knitr::kable(as.data.frame(data), caption = caption, digits = digits))
  invisible(data)
}

render_image <- function(path, width = "88%") {
  if (is.na(path) || !file.exists(path)) {
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  cat(sprintf("![](%s){width=%s fig-align='center'}\n\n", normalizePath(path, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE), width))
}

list_plot_paths <- function(pattern, directory = analysis_paths$outputs_plots) {
  sort(list.files(directory, pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE))
}

show_table <- function(x, digits = 3, caption = NULL) {
  if (is.null(x) || nrow(as.data.frame(x)) == 0) {
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  print(knitr::kable(as.data.frame(x), digits = digits, caption = caption))
  invisible(x)
}

fixed_effects_table <- function(bundle) {
  extract_fixed_effects(bundle)
}

random_effects_table <- function(bundle) {
  tryCatch(
    tidy_model_random_effects(bundle$model, conf.int = TRUE),
    error = function(e) data.frame(note = conditionMessage(e), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  )
}

model_fit_table <- function(bundle) {
  model_fit_statistics(bundle)
}

print_model_summary <- function(bundle) {
  cat("\n### Full model summary\n\n")
  print(summary(bundle$model))
}

show_saved_image <- function(path, width = "88%") {
  if (!is.null(path) && length(path) == 1 && !is.na(path) && file.exists(path)) {
    render_image(path, width = width)
  } else {
    cat("Plot was not produced.\n\n")
  }
}

read_manifest_csv <- function(name) {
  path <- file.path(analysis_paths$outputs_tables, name)
  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    return(data.frame())
  }
  utils::read.csv(path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

bundle_output_stub <- function(bundle) {
  if (identical(bundle$model_family, "family_1")) {
    return(build_model_stub("family1", bundle$response_name))
  }
  build_model_stub(bundle$model_family, bundle$response_name, bundle$acoustic_measure)
}

load_manifest_bundles <- function(manifest) {
  if (is.null(manifest) || nrow(manifest) == 0 || !"model_path" %in% names(manifest)) {
    return(list())
  }

  bundles <- lapply(manifest$model_path[file.exists(manifest$model_path)], load_model_bundle)
  names(bundles) <- manifest$model_path[file.exists(manifest$model_path)]
  bundles
}

render_bundle_section <- function(bundle) {
  output_stub <- bundle_output_stub(bundle)
  cat(sprintf("## %s\n\n", output_stub))
  cat("### Model formula\n\n")
  cat("```r\n")
  cat(paste(deparse(bundle$fitted_formula), collapse = " "))
  cat("\n```\n\n")
  show_table(model_fit_table(bundle), digits = 3, caption = "Model fit statistics")
  show_table(fixed_effects_table(bundle), digits = 3, caption = "Fixed effects")
  show_table(random_effects_table(bundle), digits = 3, caption = "Random effects")
  print_model_summary(bundle)

  cat("\n### Saved figures\n\n")
  show_saved_image(file.path(analysis_paths$outputs_plots, sprintf("%s_forest.png", output_stub)))
  show_saved_image(file.path(analysis_paths$outputs_plots, sprintf("%s_predictions.png", output_stub)))
  show_saved_image(file.path(analysis_paths$outputs_diagnostics, sprintf("%s_residual_vs_fitted.png", output_stub)), width = "80%")
  show_saved_image(file.path(analysis_paths$outputs_diagnostics, sprintf("%s_qq.png", output_stub)), width = "80%")
  show_saved_image(file.path(analysis_paths$outputs_diagnostics, sprintf("%s_observed_vs_fitted.png", output_stub)), width = "80%")
}

family1_fixed <- read_output_csv("family1_fixed_effects_summary.csv")
family2_count_fixed <- read_output_csv("family2_count_fixed_effects_summary.csv")
family2_duration_fixed <- read_output_csv("family2_duration_fixed_effects_summary.csv")
fit_stats <- read_output_csv("model_fit_statistics_summary.csv")
diagnostics_summary <- read_output_csv("diagnostics_summary.csv")
vif_summary <- read_output_csv("vif_summary.csv")
participant_descriptives <- read_output_csv("participant_descriptives.csv")
speaker_descriptives <- read_output_csv("speaker_descriptives.csv")
missingness_summary <- read_output_csv("missingness_summary.csv")
complete_case_counts <- read_output_csv("complete_case_counts.csv")
merge_summary <- read_output_csv("merge_summary.csv")
acoustic_correlations <- read_output_csv("acoustic_correlations.csv")
pca_summary <- read_output_csv("pca_summary.csv")
variation_checks <- read_output_csv("variation_checks.csv")
family1_manifest <- read_manifest_csv("family1_manifest.csv")
family2_manifest <- read_manifest_csv("family2_manifest.csv")
model_bundles <- c(load_manifest_bundles(family1_manifest), load_manifest_bundles(family2_manifest))
selection_table <- if (length(model_bundles) > 0) selection_table_from_bundles(model_bundles) else data.frame()
```

# 1. Purpose and execution order

This report follows the same general manual-knit pattern as the older HindiBabyNet VocalInputStats report, but it targets the ProsodyStats workflow.

The report can work in two modes:

1. If `params$run_workflow` is `TRUE`, knitting reruns the full workflow from the project root.
2. If `params$run_workflow` is `FALSE`, knitting only reads the already-saved CSV tables and plot files.

If the report appears stuck, the usual reason is that `params$run_workflow` is enabled and the knit is rerunning all prosody models plus bootstrap prediction intervals. With the current config, that means up to 24 mixed-effects models across Family 1 and Family 2, plus diagnostics, estimated marginal means, forest plots, and prediction grids. That is slow, but it is model fitting rather than a frozen editor.

For routine report rebuilding, keep `params$run_workflow = FALSE` and knit only from previously saved outputs. Use `params$run_workflow = TRUE` only when you want the report to rerun data preparation and model fitting.

# 1.1 What to change in this .Rmd file

Edit the `params:` block at the top of this file.

- `run_workflow`: set to `true` only when you want knitting to rerun the full ProsodyStats workflow.
- `nsim`: controls the number of Monte Carlo draws used for prediction intervals.
- `model_robustness_mode`: use `"strict"` to fit only the requested model configuration or `"auto"` to allow optimizer retries.
- `family1_age_specification`, `family2_count_age_specification`, and `family2_duration_age_specification`: use `"none"`, `"linear"`, or `"quadratic"`.
- `speaker_reference_level`, `child_sex_reference_level`, and `city_reference_level`: control categorical reference levels used when the scripts rerun.
- `SES` is treated like VocalInputStats: the scripts convert ordered SES labels to a continuous score `SES_num` using the fixed mapping `primary_school = 1`, `high_school = 2`, `Intermediate = 3`, `bachelor = 4`, `master = 5`.
- `primary_acoustic_measures` and `sensitivity_acoustic_measures`: control which acoustic variables the downstream scripts target.

After you edit the parameter block, rerender the report. If `run_workflow: true`, the saved model bundles, predictions, diagnostics, and summary tables will be regenerated using the new specification.

# 2. Project overview

This report reproduces the HindiBabyNet prosody statistical-analysis workflow from the project root. It prepares a participant-by-speaker long dataset, fits two mixed-effects model families, writes diagnostics and predictions, and assembles summary tables and figures.

# 3. Data sources

- Acoustic features: `HindiBabyNet-ProsodyModel/outputs/participant_speaker_acoustic_features.csv`
- Participant metadata and child outcomes: `HindiBabyNet-VocalInputStats/data/derived/final_master.csv`
- Speaker-level input measures: `HindiBabyNet-VocalInputStats/data/derived/input_long.csv`
- Repeated child outcomes by speaker row: `HindiBabyNet-VocalInputStats/data/derived/input_output_long.csv`
- Participant lookup validation: `Data/Audio_metadata/participant_lookup.csv`

# 8. Model Family 1 results

The Family 1 primary formula is:

`acoustic_measure ~ speaker * age_z + SES_num + child_sex + city + (1 | participant_id)`

```{r family1-tables}
render_table(family1_fixed, "Model Family 1 fixed effects")
```

```{r family1-plots, results='asis'}
for (path in list_plot_paths("^family1__.*_(forest|predictions)\\.png$")) {
  render_image(path)
}
```

```{r family1-model-summaries, results='asis'}
family1_bundles <- Filter(function(bundle) identical(bundle$model_family, "family_1"), model_bundles)
for (bundle in family1_bundles) {
  render_bundle_section(bundle)
}
```
